title: Skip repeated movements when Pluggy mints a new id

demand.statement: Production sync of Pluggy Bank on 2026-08-28 stored SALARIO EMPRESA XYZ LTDA four times because each copy had a different pluggy_transaction_id. The unique constraint on (account_id, pluggy_transaction_id) does not stop a later fetch that mints a new id for the same description, amount, and date. app.seed does not insert transactions and must stay unchanged. Credit-card bill payments are out of scope.
